text:
Alex Tran: Quick heads-up — my flight to SFO is delayed and I won't make the 10pm handoff. I need someone to cover the 22:00–02:00 UTC block tonight. I was going to monitor the planned maintenance at ~23:00 (DB schema patch).

Priya Singh: I can take 22:00–00:30 if that helps. Not comfortable staying past midnight though.

Sara Kim: I can pick up 00:30–02:00 if Priya does the first half. Otherwise I can take the whole block if no one else steps up.

Alex Tran: @Priya @Sara thank you — huge help. Notes: maintenance-bot scheduled a DB patch at 23:00 UTC (see message below). Main risk is the auth-service migrations stalling; keep an eye on the auth-migration job and API 5xx rate.

maintenance-bot: Reminder: DB patch (auth-db) scheduled at 2026-03-17T23:00:00Z. Expected ~10m downtime on write replicas. No manual action unless rollback triggered.

Quinn Li: If someone is covering, please run the quick smoke after the patch:
```
# sanity checks
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=auth | grep Running
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://api.redwood.example/health
# check migration job
kubectl -n infra get job auth-migration -o jsonpath='{.status}'
```

Alex Tran: handoff notes (short):
- open alerts: auth-5xx rate > 2% (Pager), redis-latency > 200ms (Slack alert).
- runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/auth-db-migration
- if auth migration stuck >5m, escalate: tag @Mike R. and run `kubectl logs job/auth-migration --follow` then prepare rollback per runbook.

Priya Singh: I can take first half. Will follow the runbook and ping in thread at 23:05 with smoke results. :thumbsup:

Sara Kim: I'm on for second half then. I'll monitor dashboards and stay reachable. If anything spikes, I can extend by 30m.

Mike R.: Thanks team. If you need me during the window, ping here and i'll jump in. Bookmark the rollback steps in the runbook — they look tedious but straightforward.

Alex Tran: Appreciate it. I'll update the oncall calendar and add a short note on the incident channel in case someone else hits the DB patch. Leaving TTL for escalation at 15m.

Priya Singh: 23:06 follow-up: pre-patch checks green, auth-migration job not yet started. I'll post results after patch.

Sara Kim: Thanks. Leaving a quick checklist in case Priya needs to handoff early:
- confirm 200 on /health
- check migration job status
- confirm no schema errors in DB logs: `kubectl logs -n infra job/auth-migration`
- if rollback, run `psql -h auth-db-replica -c "SELECT * FROM migration_status;"` then follow runbook steps.

Alex Tran: All set. Travelling now — will be offline till tomorrow morning but will check thread after landing. Good luck and thanks again! :pray:
